pipeline.evidence: Anisotropic motion blur (x_distortion radius=5, gaussian-weighted sigma=3, random angle). Wiener kernel corr 0.828-0.87 (gaussian 0.707, lens 0.699, glass 0.653); motion:1 simulation reproduces target blur fingerprint gm_ratio 0.572 (target 0.582), spectral_slope -1.377 (target -1.363), ratio 1.051 (target 1.041); CI 10/10 pair0 x2, 10/10 pairs2-4, 9/10 pair1. PSNR 22.7-34.5 dB is angle-limited (non-deterministic angle per call).

alternatives.note: same-family severity alternative; signal fingerprint over-blurs vs target (gm 0.488 vs 0.582)
isotropic cross-family runner-up; fails overshoot/zc CI metrics on pair0 and pair3 (6/10)
disk-kernel cross-family runner-up; no better than gaussian in CI

analysis.mode: PSNR + content-independent CI + signal fingerprint (sigma=0.74 < 2 -> PSNR usable; blur angle non-deterministic)
analysis.rationale: Pair0 signal analysis: block_boundary=0.987 (<1.05, no JPEG), unique_G 238/254 (no quantization), variance_ratio=0.992 + mean_shift=-0.4 (no global), wavelet sigma=0.74 and peeled 6-step all explained by structured blur residual (NO_NOISE). gm_ratio=0.582 vs spectral_slope_ratio=1.041 is inconsistent with isotropic blur (which would need sev>=3 for gm 0.58 and would steepen slope more); gaussian/lens severity scans plateaued at 31.5-32.2 dB with CI 5-8/10, while the anisotropic motion family matched the Wiener kernel (0.83-0.87 vs 0.65-0.71) and blur_motion:1 reproduces the target fingerprint almost exactly (gm 0.572 vs 0.582; slope -1.377 vs -1.363) with CI 10/10 on pair0 (x2) and support pairs 2/3/4 (9/10 pair1). Control: gaussian:2 on pair3 only reaches CI 6/10. Verdict is UNCERTAIN per SKILL rules (blur PSNR 30-40 dB band; blur_motion draws a random angle each call so PSNR cannot reach >40 dB even when correct, best 34.49 dB).
